abstract: Connect goose, the open-source AI agent (Desktop and CLI, aaif-goose/goose, formerly block/goose), to self-hosted and gateway endpoints. Covers the OpenAI provider host and base path, custom provider JSON for OpenAI, Anthropic and Ollama engines, built-in LM Studio, llama-swap, LiteLLM and Ollama providers, key storage and command-based credentials, model and context mapping, tool calling and the tool shim, streaming, update, and troubleshooting, with provider and environment templates.
